market.what: new-type film-forming electrolyte additives (LiPO2F2, LiDFOB, DTD, LiBOB...), world, excl. LiFSI and bulk VC/FEC
market.method: 29.4 kt x ~$17/kg = RMB 3.56B (~$0.50B); QYR $1.04B (2024) incl. LiFSI; all additives incl. VC/FEC ~$1.9B (Grand View)

value.logic: est. ~0.5 TWh/yr NMC+LCO cells could run higher cut-off voltage; +5% usable energy x ~$90/kWh cell = $2.3B/yr; longer fast-charge life is extra
value.revenue_logic: 2032 est. 1.2 TWh high-V cells x 1.1 kg electrolyte/kWh x 0.5 wt% = 6.5 kt; 10% share x $40/kg
value.margin_logic: premium additive priced above LiPO2F2; Chinese makers push prices down; license to an electrolyte maker gives 90 on royalty

trend.drivers: Li-ion demand 2.26 TWh (2025) to ~6.3 TWh (2030); new additives 29 kt to 91 kt by 2030; fast-charge EVs, 4.5V+ LCO
trend.deadline: China GB 38031-2025 (no fire, no explosion; test after 300 fast charges) mandatory 1 Jul 2026

competition.notes: crowded field. SES AI public and JV with Hisun for AI-found electrolytes; Chemix $20M Series A; Aionics ~$12M total. Chinese incumbents own VC/LiPO2F2 capacity; VC price went RMB 45k->230k/t in a year

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom (small fluorinated/sulfur/boron molecules; some catalog analogs); 3 variants
lab.test: NMC811/graphite or LCO 4.5V dry pouch cells, formation + 300 cycles at 4.4-4.5V and 45C, EIS, gas volume; university or contract battery lab
lab.logic: synth 5 wk + cycling 9 wk; synth 3 x ~$5k = $15k + 24 cells x ~$200/channel/month x 2.5 mo = $12k + cells/analysis ~$8k

sale.gates: cell-maker material qual 6-12 mo; customer cell program 1-2 yr (consumer faster, EV 3-4 yr with PPAP); toll make via electrolyte maker
